chapterInfo.content:
3
Yerusalem mmɔborɔ asetena
1Due, atuateɛ kuro a wɔagu ho fi,
nhyɛsofoɔ kuro.
2Wantie AWURADE asɛm,
wannye nkyerɛkyerɛ,
wamfa ne ho anto AWURADE so,
wammɛn ne Nyankopɔn.
3 # Hes 22.27 Emu mmapɔmma
yɛ agyata a wɔbobom,
n’atemmufoɔ nso yɛ anwummerɛ mpataku,
wɔnnya biribi nkɔsi anɔpa.
4 # Mika 3.11 N’adiyifoɔ yɛ ahohoahoafoɔ, nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ ara nko,
n’asɔfoɔ gu kronkronbea ho fi,
wɔdi mmara ho asɛmmɔne.
5AWURADE a ɔwɔ ne mu no yɛ ɔteneneeni,
ɔrenyɛ abusudeɛ;
daa n’atemmuo da adi pefee,
ɔnnyae da,
nanso okontonkyini deɛ, ɔnnim aniwuo.
6Matwitwa amanaman agu,
wɔn abantenten atifi adanedane afo,
mama wɔn mmorɔno so adeda mpan
a obiara ntwam soɔ,
wɔasɛesɛe wɔn nkuro
a onipa nni mu, na obiara nte mu.
7Mekaa sɛ: Suro me ara,
gye nkyerɛkyerɛ,
na wɔrentwa wo tenabea ntwene,
deɛ mahyɛ woɔ no nyinaa ho;
nanso wotuaa nhema
sɛesɛee wo nneyɛɛ nyinaa.
8 # Yoel 3.2; Dwom 79.6 Enti monhwɛ me kwan, AWURADE asɛm nie,
nkɔsi da a mɛsɔre mabɛgye asadeɛ.
Na ɛyɛ m’atemmudeɛ sɛ meboa amanaman ano
na mehyia ahennie aman,
na mahwie m’abohuro,
m’abufuhyeɛ nyinaa, agu wɔn so;
na me ninkuntwe gya no mu
asase no nyinaa bɛhye.
9Na ɛno ansa na mɛdane amanaman ano
ayɛ no kronkron,
sɛ wɔn nyinaa mmɔ AWURADE din no,
na wɔnyɛ anokorɔ nsom no.
10 # Dwom 68.31; Aso 8.27 Etiopia nsubɔntene agya
no ho na me nkurɔfoɔ a wɔbɔɔ wɔn peteeɛ no
bɛfiri de m’aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ abrɛ me.
11Ɛda no mɛyi w’animguaseɛ nneyɛɛ
a wode too me mmara no
nyinaa afiri hɔ,
na mɛyi wɔn a wɔdi ahantan mu ahurisie no afiri wo mu,
na worenkɔ so nkyerɛ wo ho,
me bepɔ kronkron no so.
12 # Hes 6.8 Na mɛma amanehunufoɔ ne mmɔborɔfoɔ
aka wo mu,
na wɔde wɔn ho ato AWURADE din no so.
13Israel nkaeɛ no
renyɛ akɔntɔnkyedeɛ,
na wɔrenka atorosɛm,
na wɔrenhunu
nsisie tɛkyerɛma wɔn anomu,
na wɔn deɛ, wɔbɛyɛne wɔn ho na wɔabutubutu hɔ,
na obiara renyi wɔn hu.
Nkwagyeɛ ho ayeyie
14 # Sak 9.9 To ahurisie dwom, Sion babaa;
bɔ ose, Israel,
ma w’ani nnye, na fa akoma nyinaa di ahurisie,
Yerusalem babaa.
15AWURADE ayi w’atemmudeɛ no kɔ,
wato w’atamfo agu;
AWURADE, Israel hene no wɔ wo mu,
worenhunu amane bio.
16Ɛda no wɔbɛka akyerɛ Yerusalem sɛ:
Nsuro, Sion,
mma wo nsam nnhodwo.
17 # Yes 62.5 AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo mu no
yɛ ɛdɔnkunini, ɔgyefoɔ;
ɔde anigyeɛ bɛdi wo ho ahurisie,
ɔde dɔ bɛyɛ wo foforɔ,
ɔde nnwom bɛbɔ se wɔ wo ho.
18Meboaboa mo ano na mo asane adi afahyɛ
a modi ho abooboo no bio,
na moansoa ɛho ahohora.
19 # Mika 4.7 Hwɛ, me ne w’ahafoɔ nyinaa bɛdi,
ɛberɛ no mu,
na mɛgye asiiɛfoɔ no,
na matase wɔn a wɔapam wɔn no;
mɛma wɔanya animuonyam ne din wɔ
asase a wɔn anim agu ase nyinaa so.
20 # Yer 29.14; Sef 2.7 Ɛberɛ no mu na mede mo bɛba,
na ɛberɛ no na mɛboa mo ano.
Na mɛma mo animuonyam ne din
wɔ asase aman nyinaa so,
ɛberɛ a mede mo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔfaa wɔn nnommum bɛsane aba no,
mo ara mo de mo ani bɛhunu, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
